spans.s:
śaila‿agra, n. mountain top;
 -adhirāja, m. sovereign of mountains, Himālaya: 🞄-tanayā, f. daughter of the Himālaya, Pārvatī.

śaílāli, m. pat. (fr. śilālin) of a 🞄teacher: -n, m. pl. school of Śilālin;
 i-yuvan, m. dancer, actor.
śail-ī, f. [fr. śīla] habit, custom, conduct, 🞄procedure.
śailūṣá, m. (pat. fr. śilūṣa) dancer, 🞄actor (their wives are in ill-repute): ī, f. 🞄female dancer, actress.
śail-eya, m. n. (produced from stone, 🞄śilā), benzoin, bitumen, etc..
